verdict.rationale: EFTPS's own pages state only that a tax professional can make payments for multiple clients under one login, and suggest having a tax professional or payroll provider pay for you. That is a thin, first-party statement of what a third party may do. Nothing defines the scope of that delegation. Missing for 10: published authorization/enrollment forms for third-party access, a defined role model, limits on what a third party may NOT do, and which signatures or attestations must stay with the taxpayer.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: If you're a tax professional, you can make payments for multiple clients under a single login.
consult a tax professional or payroll provider about making payments for you
